title: Ravagers on the Ice
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.Brede sent you up to Ketil, a worm tracker at the Last Fire. Yeti ravagers have come onto the Glacier's Foot, east of the fire, and they're robbing his traps. He wants eight of them dead.

About

Given byKetil
Level60
LengthMedium
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

Nothing to bring in the steps recorded so far.

Steps

  1. Talk to Ketil (outdoors around 74, -1061) to get the quest.
  2. Kill 8 yeti ravagers (8)
  3. Report to Ketil at 75, -1061

Rewards

Reward
Gold8,992
Character XP281,000
Quest points1

What Ketil says

Ketil: Eight. Brede was right about you.

Ketil: They won't go back down to the highlands, though. I've watched them. The cold up here suits them better.

Handing it in
